NS-1.title: Establish network segmentation boundaries
NS-1.description: Ensure that your virtual network deployment aligns to your enterprise segmentation strategy. Any workload that could incur higher risk for the organization should be isolated in its own virtual network.

NS-2.title: Secure cloud native services with network controls
NS-2.description: Use private endpoints for Azure PaaS services to avoid data exposure via public endpoints. Disable public network access where possible.

NS-3.title: Deploy firewall at the edge of enterprise network
NS-3.description: Deploy Azure Firewall or a compatible network virtual appliance (NVA) to filter traffic at the network perimeter.

NS-4.title: Deploy intrusion detection/intrusion prevention systems (IDS/IPS)
NS-4.description: Use Azure Firewall Premium or third-party IDS/IPS with DDoS protection and WAF to inspect and filter network traffic.

NS-5.title: Deploy DDOS protection
NS-5.description: Deploy Azure DDoS Protection on virtual networks hosting critical workloads.

NS-6.title: Deploy web application firewall
NS-6.description: Deploy Azure WAF in front of web-facing applications and configure appropriate rules or virtual patches.

NS-7.title: Simplify network security configuration
NS-7.description: Use Application Security Groups (ASGs) and Azure Firewall Manager to simplify and centrally manage NSG rules and firewall policies.

NS-8.title: Detect and disable insecure services and protocols
NS-8.description: Detect and disable insecure services and protocols such as SSL/TLS v1.0/1.1, SSHv1, SMBv1, and other legacy protocols.

NS-9.title: Connect on-premises or cloud network privately
NS-9.description: Use Azure ExpressRoute or VPN with proper encryption to securely connect on-premises networks to Azure.

NS-10.title: Ensure Domain Name System (DNS) security
NS-10.description: Use Azure DNS or Azure Private DNS and configure DNS security settings including DNSSEC.

IM-1.title: Use centralized identity and authentication system
IM-1.description: Use Microsoft Entra ID as the centralized identity and authentication management system for all cloud resources.

IM-2.title: Protect identity and authentication system
IM-2.description: Secure your identity and authentication system by enabling security defaults, Conditional Access policies, and monitoring sign-in risks.

IM-3.title: Manage application identities securely
IM-3.description: Use managed identities instead of service principals with credentials. Avoid embedding credentials in code or configuration.

IM-4.title: Authenticate server and services
IM-4.description: Use managed identities to authenticate Azure services instead of stored credentials.

IM-5.title: Use single sign-on (SSO) for application access
IM-5.description: Use Entra ID SSO for application access to simplify identity management and improve user experience.

IM-6.title: Use strong authentication controls
IM-6.description: Enforce MFA for all users including administrators. Use passwordless authentication methods where possible.

IM-7.title: Restrict resource access based on conditions
IM-7.description: Use Conditional Access policies to enforce access controls based on conditions such as device compliance, location, and risk level.

IM-8.title: Restrict exposure of credentials and secrets
IM-8.description: Store credentials and secrets in Azure Key Vault. Never embed them in code, configuration, or deployment scripts.

DP-1.title: Discover, classify, and label sensitive data
DP-1.description: Use Microsoft Purview or equivalent to discover, classify, and label sensitive data across your Azure environment.

DP-2.title: Monitor anomalies and threats targeting sensitive data
DP-2.description: Enable advanced threat protection on data stores to monitor for anomalies and threats targeting sensitive data.

DP-3.title: Encrypt sensitive data in transit
DP-3.description: Enforce TLS 1.2 or higher for all data in transit. Disable older TLS/SSL versions.

DP-4.title: Enable data at rest encryption by default
DP-4.description: Ensure all data stores use platform encryption at rest by default (SSE with Microsoft-managed keys).

DP-5.title: Use customer-managed key option in data at rest encryption when required
DP-5.description: Where required by compliance, use customer-managed keys (CMK) with Azure Key Vault for data at rest encryption.

DP-6.title: Use a secure key management process
DP-6.description: Define and implement a key management process including key generation, distribution, storage, rotation, revocation, and access control.

DP-7.title: Use a secure certificate management process
DP-7.description: Manage TLS/SSL certificates through Azure Key Vault with auto-renewal and proper access controls.

DP-8.title: Ensure security of key and certificate repository
DP-8.description: Secure Key Vault with soft-delete, purge protection, RBAC, network restrictions, and logging.

PA-1.title: Separate and limit highly privileged/administrative users
PA-1.description: Limit the number of highly privileged accounts (Owner, Contributor at subscription level). Use dedicated admin accounts.

PA-2.title: Avoid standing access for user accounts and permissions
PA-2.description: Use Privileged Identity Management (PIM) for just-in-time (JIT) access to privileged roles instead of permanent assignments.

PA-3.title: Manage lifecycle of identities and entitlements
PA-3.description: Implement identity lifecycle management processes including access reviews and entitlement management.

PA-4.title: Review and reconcile user access regularly
PA-4.description: Conduct regular access reviews for privileged roles and ensure alignment with business needs.

PA-5.title: Set up emergency access
PA-5.description: Create and secure break-glass emergency access accounts to prevent lockout from the Entra ID tenant.

PA-6.title: Use privileged access workstations
PA-6.description: Use Privileged Access Workstations (PAW) for administrative tasks to reduce the risk of credential theft.

PA-7.title: Follow just enough administration (least privilege) principle
PA-7.description: Use Azure RBAC to assign the minimum required permissions. Prefer built-in roles over custom roles.

PA-8.title: Determine access process for cloud provider support
PA-8.description: Establish a clear process for granting and revoking cloud provider support access. Use Customer Lockbox.

AM-1.title: Track asset inventory and their risks
AM-1.description: Maintain a comprehensive inventory of all cloud assets using Azure Resource Graph and track their risk levels.

AM-2.title: Use only approved services
AM-2.description: Use Azure Policy to restrict which Azure services can be provisioned. Define and enforce allowed service lists.

AM-3.title: Ensure security of asset lifecycle management
AM-3.description: Implement secure asset lifecycle management processes including provisioning, configuration, monitoring, and decommissioning.

AM-4.title: Limit access to asset management
AM-4.description: Restrict who can modify resource configurations using RBAC. Use resource locks for critical resources.

AM-5.title: Use only approved applications in virtual machine
AM-5.description: Use adaptive application controls to ensure only approved applications run on virtual machines.

LT-1.title: Enable threat detection capabilities
LT-1.description: Enable Microsoft Defender for Cloud plans for all supported resource types to detect threats and anomalies.

LT-2.title: Enable threat detection for identity and access management
LT-2.description: Enable Entra ID Protection and identity-based threat detection to identify suspicious sign-in and identity-related risks.

LT-3.title: Enable logging for security investigation
LT-3.description: Enable diagnostic settings on all Azure resources to capture control plane and data plane logs.

LT-4.title: Enable network logging for security investigation
LT-4.description: Enable NSG flow logs and Traffic Analytics for network security investigation and monitoring.

LT-5.title: Centralize security log management and analysis
LT-5.description: Centralize log collection in a Log Analytics workspace for correlation, analysis, and alerting.

LT-6.title: Configure log storage retention
LT-6.description: Configure appropriate log retention periods (minimum 90 days for security logs, longer for compliance).

LT-7.title: Use approved time synchronization sources
LT-7.description: Use trusted NTP time sources for all systems to ensure accurate and synchronized log timestamps.

IR-1.title: Preparation - update incident response plan and handling process
IR-1.description: Develop and maintain an incident response plan that covers the full lifecycle of incidents.

IR-2.title: Preparation - setup incident notification
IR-2.description: Configure security contacts and alert notifications in Microsoft Defender for Cloud.

IR-3.title: Detection and analysis - create incidents based on high quality alerts
IR-3.description: Create incident management processes that leverage high-quality alerts from Defender for Cloud and Sentinel.

IR-4.title: Detection and analysis - investigate an incident
IR-4.description: Establish investigation procedures and use Microsoft Sentinel for incident investigation and threat hunting.

IR-5.title: Detection and analysis - prioritize incidents
IR-5.description: Prioritize incidents based on alert severity and asset sensitivity using automated enrichment and correlation.

IR-6.title: Containment, eradication and recovery
IR-6.description: Implement containment procedures including isolation, eradication of threats, and recovery to a known good state.

IR-7.title: Post-incident activity
IR-7.description: Conduct post-incident reviews, update incident response procedures, and retain evidence as required.

PV-1.title: Define and establish secure configurations
PV-1.description: Define security configuration baselines using Azure Policy and MCSB recommendations.

PV-2.title: Audit and enforce secure configurations
PV-2.description: Monitor compliance using Azure Policy and remediate non-compliant resources automatically or manually.

PV-3.title: Define and establish secure configurations for compute resources
PV-3.description: Define secure baselines for VMs and containers using Azure Policy guest configuration and Defender recommendations.

PV-4.title: Audit and enforce secure configurations for compute resources
PV-4.description: Monitor VM and container security configurations and remediate deviations from baselines.

PV-5.title: Perform vulnerability assessments
PV-5.description: Enable and run vulnerability assessments using Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management on servers, containers, and databases.

PV-6.title: Rapidly and automatically remediate vulnerabilities
PV-6.description: Establish SLAs for vulnerability remediation and use automation to patch and remediate rapidly.

PV-7.title: Conduct regular red team operations
PV-7.description: Conduct regular penetration testing and red team exercises to identify vulnerabilities and gaps.

ES-1.title: Use Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR)
ES-1.description: Enable Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (MDE) on all servers and VMs for endpoint detection and response.

ES-2.title: Use modern anti-malware software
ES-2.description: Deploy Microsoft Antimalware or an equivalent anti-malware solution on all VMs and VMSS.

ES-3.title: Ensure anti-malware software and signatures are updated
ES-3.description: Ensure anti-malware signatures and engine are updated automatically and regularly.

BR-1.title: Ensure regular automated backups
BR-1.description: Enable Azure Backup for VMs, databases, and critical workloads with appropriate backup policies.

BR-2.title: Protect backup and recovery data
BR-2.description: Enable soft-delete, immutability, and encryption on backup vaults to protect against accidental or malicious deletion.

BR-3.title: Monitor backups
BR-3.description: Configure backup monitoring alerts and regularly review backup job status and compliance.

BR-4.title: Regularly test backup
BR-4.description: Conduct regular backup restore tests to validate recoverability and ensure RTO/RPO objectives are met.

DS-1.title: Conduct threat modeling
DS-1.description: Perform threat modeling for applications and infrastructure to identify risks and design mitigations.

DS-2.title: Ensure software supply chain security
DS-2.description: Implement supply chain security practices including dependency scanning, SBOM generation, and artifact signing.

DS-3.title: Secure DevOps infrastructure
DS-3.description: Secure CI/CD pipeline infrastructure including source control, build systems, and deployment tools.

DS-4.title: Integrate static application security testing into DevOps pipeline
DS-4.description: Integrate SAST tools in CI/CD pipelines to detect vulnerabilities in source code before deployment.

DS-5.title: Integrate dynamic application security testing into DevOps pipeline
DS-5.description: Integrate DAST tools in CI/CD pipelines to detect runtime vulnerabilities in deployed applications.

DS-6.title: Enforce security of workload throughout DevOps lifecycle
DS-6.description: Enforce security gates, approvals, and compliance checks throughout the development and deployment lifecycle.

DS-7.title: Ensure logging and monitoring in DevOps
DS-7.description: Enable audit logging for CI/CD pipelines, source repositories, and deployment activities.

GS-1.title: Align organization roles, responsibilities, and accountabilities
GS-1.description: Define clear security roles and responsibilities across the organization with documented accountability.

GS-2.title: Define and implement enterprise segmentation/separation of duties strategy
GS-2.description: Establish enterprise-wide segmentation strategy aligned with management groups, subscriptions, and resource groups.

GS-3.title: Define and implement data protection strategy
GS-3.description: Establish a comprehensive data protection strategy covering classification, encryption, access control, and retention.

GS-4.title: Define and implement network security strategy
GS-4.description: Define a network security strategy covering network architecture, segmentation, perimeter defense, and traffic filtering.

GS-5.title: Define and implement security posture management strategy
GS-5.description: Implement continuous security posture management using Defender for Cloud secure score and compliance dashboards.

GS-6.title: Define and implement identity and privileged access strategy
GS-6.description: Establish an identity and privileged access strategy including MFA, Conditional Access, PIM, and identity governance.

GS-7.title: Define and implement logging, threat detection, and incident response strategy
GS-7.description: Establish a comprehensive logging and threat detection strategy with Sentinel, Defender for Cloud, and incident response procedures.

GS-8.title: Define and implement backup and recovery strategy
GS-8.description: Define backup and recovery strategy including RPO/RTO objectives, backup policies, and regular restore testing.

GS-9.title: Define and implement endpoint security strategy
GS-9.description: Establish endpoint security strategy covering EDR, anti-malware, patch management, and secure configuration.

GS-10.title: Define and implement DevOps security strategy
GS-10.description: Establish DevOps security strategy covering secure SDLC, supply chain security, and pipeline hardening.

GS-11.title: Define and implement multi-cloud security strategy
GS-11.description: Extend security governance across multi-cloud environments using Azure Arc, Defender for Cloud multi-cloud connectors.
